summary: Moved all date/time parsing into deskstats/timeparse.py, with the other modules delegating and keeping their public functions. Added tests/test_timeparse.py; all tests pass under UTC and America/New_York. Quirks kept as they were: sources disagree on offsetless times, two-digit years are only expanded for roster days, 24:00 only works in the roster, and inputs that used to crash with OverflowError (e.g. 'inf' epochs, huge years) still crash from the sources, though timeparse itself raises ValueError for them.
